products.name: Dinorado Premium Rice
products.short_description:
Aromatic, soft and slightly sticky premium rice — a favourite for everyday meals and special occasions.

  • Premium grade, low broken-grain ratio
  • Packed in food-grade sealed bags
  • Available from 1 kg packs to 25 kg sacks
products.description:
Dinorado is prized for its natural aroma and tender texture. Our demo lots are milled in small batches and sealed to keep the grains fresh.

Choose a 1 kg pack to try it, or a 25 kg sack for households, carinderias and canteens. Need more than five sacks or a regular weekly delivery? Use Request a quotation for volume pricing.

Storage

Keep in a cool, dry place in an airtight container.

reviews.author: Sample Reviewer — carinderia owner
reviews.content: Consistent quality per sack and delivered on time. (Sample review for demonstration.)

reviews.author: Sample Reviewer R.
reviews.content: Fragrant and soft. The 5 kg pack is just right for our family. (Sample review for demonstration.)

products.name: Jasmine Fragrant Rice
products.short_description:
Long-grain fragrant rice with a light, fluffy texture.

  • Long-grain, low moisture
  • Great for fried rice and silog
  • 1 kg, 5 kg and 25 kg
products.description: A long-grain jasmine variety grown in Central Luzon. It cooks up light and separate — ideal for fried rice and everyday meals.

products.name: Sinandomeng Well-Milled Rice
products.short_description:
The everyday well-milled rice for households and food businesses.

  • Well-milled, clean grain
  • Best value per kilo in sacks
  • Up to 50 kg sacks
products.description:
Sinandomeng is the reliable everyday rice of many Filipino kitchens — affordable, consistent and easy to cook.

The 50 kg sack gives the lowest price per kilo. For recurring supply to stores and canteens, request a quotation.

reviews.author: Sample Reviewer — sari-sari store
reviews.content: Good price per sack and clean grains. (Sample review for demonstration.)

products.name: Brown Rice 2 kg
products.short_description:
Whole-grain brown rice with a nutty flavour and more fibre.

  • Unpolished whole grain
  • 2 kg resealable pack
products.description: Brown rice keeps its bran layer for a chewier texture and nutty taste. Soak for 30 minutes before cooking for softer results.

products.name: Malagkit Glutinous Rice
products.short_description:
Sticky glutinous rice for biko, suman and champorado.

  • Sold per kilo
  • Ideal for kakanin
products.description: Malagkit becomes soft and sticky when cooked — the base of many Filipino rice cakes and desserts.

products.name: Monggo (Mung Beans)
products.short_description:
Whole green mung beans for ginisang monggo and desserts.

  • Sorted and cleaned
  • Sold per kilo
products.description: Our mung beans are sorted to remove stones and broken beans. Rinse well and simmer until soft.

products.name: Cabbage (Repolyo)
products.short_description:
Firm, crisp highland cabbage.

  • Harvested in Benguet
  • Sold per kilo (whole heads)
products.description: Tight, heavy heads from the Cordillera highlands. Great for nilaga, pancit and coleslaw. Weight is rounded to the nearest whole head; we refund any shortfall.

products.name: Tomatoes (Kamatis)
products.short_description:
Ripe, firm tomatoes for sawsawan and sauces.

  • Mixed ripeness for the week
  • Sold per kilo
products.description: Packed with a mix of ripe and turning tomatoes so they last through the week.

products.name: Eggplant (Talong)
products.short_description:
Long purple eggplant for tortang talong and pinakbet.

  • Glossy, firm skin
  • Sold per kilo
products.description: Choose eggplants that feel heavy for their size. Store unwashed in the vegetable crisper.

products.name: Red Onions (Sibuyas)
products.short_description:
Local red onions — a kitchen staple, priced per kilo or in 5 kg bags.

  • Cured for longer storage
  • Mesh bags of 5 kg for food businesses
products.description: Locally grown red onions, cured and sorted. Store in a cool, airy place away from potatoes.

products.name: Native Garlic (Bawang)
products.short_description:
Small, pungent native garlic bulbs.

  • Strong flavour, small cloves
  • Sold per kilo
products.description: Ilocos native garlic is smaller than imported varieties but far more aromatic. Currently out of season — request a quotation and we will source it for you.

products.name: Ampalaya (Bitter Gourd)
products.short_description:
Firm, bright-green bitter gourd.

  • For ginisang ampalaya and pinakbet
  • Sold per kilo
products.description: Salt and squeeze sliced ampalaya before cooking to mellow its bitterness.

products.name: Pechay Bundle
products.short_description:
Tender pechay, about 500 g per bundle.

  • Harvested within 48 hours of delivery
  • Sold per bundle
products.description: Tender Chinese cabbage for nilaga, sinigang and stir-fries. Keep wrapped in a damp paper towel in the fridge.

products.name: Carrots
products.short_description:
Sweet, crunchy highland carrots.

  • Washed and sorted
  • Sold per kilo
products.description: Highland carrots with a natural sweetness — for menudo, afritada and salads.

products.name: Saba Banana
products.short_description:
Cooking banana for turon, banana cue and ginataan.

  • Firm, just-ripening
  • Sold per kilo
products.description: Saba bananas are best cooked — fried, boiled or simmered in coconut milk.

products.name: Carabao Mango
products.short_description:
Sweet, fragrant carabao mangoes.

  • Packed at turning-ripe
  • Sold per kilo (about 3 pieces)
products.description: The famous sweet Philippine mango. Leave at room temperature for 1–2 days until fragrant and slightly soft.

reviews.author: Sample Reviewer M.
reviews.content: Very sweet and arrived well packed. (Sample review for demonstration.)

products.name: Calamansi
products.short_description:
Juicy native lime for sawsawan, juice and pancit.

  • Sold per kilo
products.description: Calamansi keeps for about two weeks in the fridge. Roll before squeezing for more juice.

products.name: Pork Liempo (Belly)
products.short_description:
Skin-on pork belly with even layers of meat and fat.

  • Chilled, never frozen (demo)
  • Sliced for grilling or whole slab
  • 500 g and 1 kg packs
products.description:
Our liempo is cut from locally raised pigs and packed chilled. Ideal for inihaw, lechon kawali and sinigang.

Need regular kilos for your restaurant? Request a quotation for scheduled deliveries.

reviews.author: Sample Reviewer J.
reviews.content: Good meat-to-fat ratio and cleanly sliced. (Sample review for demonstration.)

products.name: Pork Kasim (Shoulder)
products.short_description:
Lean-to-medium pork shoulder for adobo and menudo.

  • Cubed or whole
  • Sold per kilo
products.description: Kasim has just enough fat to stay juicy in slow-cooked dishes.

products.name: Ground Pork
products.short_description:
Freshly ground pork, 80/20 lean to fat.

  • Ground daily (demo)
  • Sold per kilo
products.description: For lumpia, embutido, picadillo and pasta sauces.

products.name: Beef Brisket
products.short_description:
Beef brisket for bulalo, kare-kare and nilaga.

  • Sold per kilo
products.description: Slow-cook brisket for tender, flavourful beef. Limited daily supply — request a quotation for larger orders.

products.name: Whole Dressed Chicken
products.short_description:
Whole dressed chicken, about 1.1–1.4 kg each.

  • Priced per kilo, billed by actual weight
products.description: For tinola, roast chicken and fried chicken. Ask us to cut it into 8 or 12 pieces in the order notes.

products.name: Chicken Breast Fillet
products.short_description:
Skinless, boneless breast fillet.

  • Trimmed and chilled
  • Sold per kilo
products.description: Lean and versatile — for grilling, salads and chicken fingers.

products.name: Fresh Eggs (Tray of 30)

Fresh chicken eggs, 30 pieces per tray.

products.name: Bangus (Milkfish)

Whole bangus, 2–3 pieces per kilo.

  • Free cleaning and slicing on request

reviews.author: Sample Reviewer L.
reviews.content: Very fresh and nicely cleaned. (Sample review for demonstration.)

products.name: Tilapia
products.short_description:
Farm-raised tilapia, 3–4 pieces per kilo.

  • Sold per kilo

products.name: Galunggong (Round Scad)
products.short_description:
Small round scad, perfect for frying.

  • Packed on ice
  • Sold per kilo
products.description: A Filipino breakfast favourite — fry until crisp and serve with rice and sawsawan.

Sweet medium shrimp for sinigang and halabos.

  • Sold per kilo

Whole squid for adobong pusit and calamares.

  • Sold per kilo

products.name: Refined White Sugar

Fine refined sugar for cooking, baking and drinks.
